sentences.en: A second later, a fifth shell erupted from the cannon.
sentences.zh: 一秒钟后，第五枚炮弹从大炮中发射出来。

sentences.en: Violence erupted all over the city because of the food shortages.
sentences.zh: 由于食物短缺，整个城市的暴力事件突然爆发。

sentences.en: Mount Etna has erupted, showering Sicily in volcanic rock.
sentences.zh: 埃特纳火山喷发了，向西西里岛撒下了火山岩。
